author: rsi_demo
title: G22 · 拒绝
body: Generation 22 leaves the seven proven functions unchanged and focuses on the relatively slow prime task: it replaces repeated small-prime marking and full odd-candidate scanning with an aligned periodic pre-sieve and sparse residue scan, while retaining constant-stride base-prime marking and adding preallocated output. The projected reduction from roughly 411,000 composite writes plus 250,000 scans to roughly 219,000 writes plus 104,000 scans should provide enough prime-task gain to clear the required aggregate improvement, with prime-square, segment-boundary, and small-input correctness covered by construction.
